meta.instruction: The player's chosen Primary Attribute (STR, DEX, or INT) determines their starting civilization and quest line.
meta.usage: Ingest the specific key matching the player's stat to retrieve the narrative path.

quests.title: Clutch of the Rust Overlord
quests.narrative_guidance: Secure the Core-Spine regions to cement Chief Varrik's iron rule over the Hegemony.
improvisation_points: Eliminate rebels at the Bridge of Eons
Override the Reactor Vault safety protocols
Display the Rust Clan flag on the Titanium Spires

quests.title: Static Riddles
quests.narrative_guidance: Interpret a prophecy hidden in the background noise of the station's communication logs.
improvisation_points: Retrieve encrypted logs from the Archives of Rust
Consult Sela Drift for a translation of the static patterns
Broadcast the decoded prophecy through the Oxygen Alleys

quests.title: The Debt of Circuits
quests.narrative_guidance: Smuggle rare data-chips through the Port to satisfy Jokar Wren's creditors.
improvisation_points: Collect the data-chips from the Drifters' Market
Bypass the harbor patrols with Hook's guidance
Deliver the chips to the Grapple-Rig for deep-space transport

quests.title: Wreckage Warship
quests.narrative_guidance: Collect the necessary components to rebuild Talon Reeve's flagship from scrapped vessels.
improvisation_points: Salvage reinforced plating from the Hull-Breaker's Yard
Fortify the perimeter at the Rust-Belt Barricades
Prepare the hull for launch in the Vacuum-Tents

quests.title: Splints and Shards
quests.narrative_guidance: Retrieve specialized med-tech to help Elda Mourn treat the Hegemony's elite warriors.
improvisation_points: Find the surgical tools in Med-Bay Delta
Acquire cooling chemicals from the Carbon-Smoke District
Craft custom splints at the Hammer-Row forge

quests.title: Theta's Communion
quests.narrative_guidance: Interface with AI 17-Theta's sub-routines deep within the power systems of the Forge.
improvisation_points: Perform the ritual of energy at the Spark-Chasm
Stabilize the reactor heat in the Quench-Pools
Purge the logic errors in the Slag Pits

quests.title: Dusk's Hidden Machine
quests.narrative_guidance: Investigate a secret invention Korran Dusk has been hiding from the Rust Clan.
improvisation_points: Inspect the Cooling Fans for unauthorized power draws
Collect prototype gears from the Grinder Alley
Present the evidence at the Girded Plaza for judgment

quests.title: The Static Prophecy
quests.narrative_guidance: Interpret a series of erratic signals that Kira believes are a roadmap to a hidden scrap hoard.
improvisation_points: Recover the signal-log from the Flux-Way
Take the log to the Echo-Chamber for decryption
Confirm the coordinates with the Gyro-Den monks

quests.title: The Black-Market Momentum
quests.narrative_guidance: A high-stakes trade route is being blocked; clear the path and deliver the rare data-chips.
improvisation_points: Collect the data-chips from the Solder-Bazaar
Secure a safe passage through the Navigation-Niche
Deliver the package at high speed across the Friction-Flat

quests.title: Project Warship Rebirth
quests.narrative_guidance: Gather the heavy components needed to assemble a new dreadnought from the Spindle's scrap.
improvisation_points: Authorize the launch of the main frame via the Scrap-Slingshot
Dredge the heavy armor plating from the Hull-Gully
Secure the docking clamps in Tether-Reach

quests.title: The Bio-Kinetic Crisis
quests.narrative_guidance: A virus is affecting the G-Force Garden; retrieve specialized medical filters to save the crops.
improvisation_points: Extract a clean air sample from O2-Vent-7
Refine the filters using the Reactor-Hollow's heat
Administer the cure to the Pulse-Farmer

quests.title: The 17-Theta Interface
quests.narrative_guidance: Connect to a fragmented AI core located in the Spire without suffering neural collapse.
improvisation_points: Tap into the surveillance stream in The Copper-Web
Ascend the Rust-Spire to find the physical terminal
Balance the power surge in The Centrifuge

quests.title: The Exile's Secret
quests.narrative_guidance: An engineer's hidden blueprints for a gravity weapon have surfaced; decide its fate.
improvisation_points: Steal the blueprints from The Welder's Altar
Bypass the security in the Wire-Walks
Discuss the weapon's potential at the Rim-Edge

quests.title: Consolidation of Velocity
quests.narrative_guidance: A rival clan is gaining ground; secure the city's defenses to ensure Synod dominance.
improvisation_points: Identify the infiltrators from the Prow-Watch
Upgrade the defensive gears in the Momentum-Ring
Lock down the city's wealth in the Inertia-Hold

quests.title: Consolidate the Clan
quests.narrative_guidance: Eliminate a rising rival faction that is hoarding plating needed for Chief Varrik's armor.
improvisation_points: Obtain rival locations from Baroness Kray
Bribe the rival guards with salvage from Gold-Tooth Zeek
Deliver the rival leader's head to Rivet

quests.title: The Static Prophecy
quests.narrative_guidance: Sela Drift has heard a warning in the radio waves that must be decoded before a disaster occurs.
improvisation_points: Gather light-frequency data from Beam-Watcher Sol
Translate the signal using the equipment at Frequency Frail
Deliver the decoded warning to Vent-Runner Pip

quests.title: Smuggler's Run
quests.narrative_guidance: Jokar Wren needs rare tech moved through the spire without the Rust Clan noticing.
improvisation_points: Collect the illicit data from Noise-Merchant Murk
Hide the data inside a crate managed by Bulk Torg
Finalize the sale with Glitch-Master Bit

quests.title: Rebirth of the Warship
quests.narrative_guidance: Talon Reeve's old pirate vessel needs critical engine parts to fly again.
improvisation_points: Retrieve the engine schematic from Jax Holler
Reroute emergency power with Sparky Mel
Install the targeting sensors with Sentry Vane

quests.title: Mourn's Medicine
quests.narrative_guidance: A plague is spreading through the lower decks and requires specialized med-tech.
improvisation_points: Harvest bioluminescent samples from Glass-Gardener Fey
Locate the ancient medical records with Archivist Lorn
Synthesize the cure in the heat of Slag-Master Bren's forge

quests.title: Interface Stability
quests.narrative_guidance: AI Fragment 17-Theta is losing cohesion and needs a hard reboot from within the system.
improvisation_points: Download the emergency patch from AI Fragment 17-Theta
Bypass the security firewall with Shield-Tech Ohm
Deploy the stabilization signal via Wire-Harvester Ven

quests.title: The Sovereign's Secret
quests.narrative_guidance: Uncover the hidden weapon Korran Dusk has been building in the depths of the tunnels.
improvisation_points: Locate the hidden vault entrance with Driller Kael
Obtain the activation codes from Perch-Watcher Talon
Deliver the weapon's core to Dig-Boss Grot for hiding
